svg.title: Token Quotient: the quote, your choice, the cap, the report
svg.desc: A film in five scenes. You ask for a big job. Quotient's quote shows three levels with total, time and share of the 5 hours and of the week. You choose max, apart now. A real job of that size stays inside its cap of 1.36 million. The report: real cost 768,134 against an estimate of 994k of work, 12 minutes against about 13 expected.

g.text: > This is a big job: the next version.
With max, you would still have:
It starts at once, in a separate session.
A real job of this size: its cap
It works up to its cap and no further.
The last 8% is kept for saving what it found.
The next quote learns from the difference.
A real job: the release of version 1.2.3.
